title: Initial Release
description: Run a local mock HTTP server from inside Voiden.

Added: Mock Server tab in the left sidebar to start and stop a local mock server.
Routes with a method, path, status, response headers, body and optional delay, saved in voiden-mocks.json at the project root.
Route edits apply while the server runs, including hand edits to voiden-mocks.json.
CORS headers and preflight handling for browser apps, and an optional LAN mode.
Request log showing headers, body, matched route and timing, with a button to add a route for an unmatched request.
